description: June 24, 2022 Nashville, TN – Today, the Supreme Court of the United States published its opinion in the landmark Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization case. In response to the opinion, State Representative John Ray Clemmons (D-Nashville) released the following statement: Today, the Supreme Court of the United States failed Tennessee families by overruling fifty years of judicial precedent. title: State Rep. Clemmons' Statement on U.S. Supreme Court Opinion Eliminating Women's Constitutional Right to Abortion - John Ray Clemmons
